summary: Keep warm conversation owner lookup consistent for newly seen agents and fence cache publication across projection repair

replay.detail: No replay or change to retained claims or conversations.

schema.detail: Only volatile routing metadata changes; no new database index, table or schema version.

rules.detail: No claim kind, checkpoint rule, digest or retention change.

compatibility.detail: A warm lookup of an agent with only a declaration or harness report now returns the existing no-current-session response, matching cold lookup, instead of incorrectly reporting that the agent does not exist. No client contract or generated file changes.

downtime.detail: Normal rolling deployment applies; no additional startup migration or rebuild beyond the existing volatile cache.

manual.detail: No operator or user action required.

recovery.detail: A projection repair or trim clears the volatile owner cache and invalidates publication by an earlier in-flight build, so later reads rebuild routing metadata from the repaired claims.
